evidence.text: The film stars Shaquille O'Neal as John Henry Irons and his alter-ego Steel , Annabeth Gish as his wheelchair-using partner Susan Sparks , and Judd Nelson as their rival Nathaniel Burke .
Steel is a 1997 American superhero action film based on the DC Comics character Steel .
Judd Asher Nelson -LRB- born November 28 , 1959 -RRB- is an American actor , screenwriter , and producer .
Cast in Steel is the tenth and last studio album by Norwegian band A-ha .
Cast in Steel is the first a-ha album to use the original band logo since Memorial Beach from 1993 , and the first album to be produced by Alan Tarney since Stay on These Roads -LRB- 1988 -RRB- .
